newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Russia declines NATO offer on exchanges.
newsitem.headline: Russia declines NATO offer on exchanges.

text.p: Russia declined on Wednesday to accept a NATO offer to exchange military liaison officers, diplomats said.
They said Russian defence minister Igor Rodionov told his NATO counterparts that it was "premature". But they said he indicated a willingness to build closer ties with the alliance.

A NATO official said earlier that if Rodionov declined to take what he termed a small step towards a charter between the former cold war enemies it would be due to internal politicking at home rather than hostility towards NATO.

Russia deeply opposes NATO plans to open talks at a July 8-9 summit in Madrid next year to admit a number of countries from behind the Iron Curtain. The most likely countries are Poland, Hungary and the Czech Republic.

NATO is adamant enlargement will go ahead, but wants it accompanied by historic new pacts with Russia and Ukraine and an internal agreement on reform of the alliance's command structure to equip it for more Bosnia-style peace missions.
